title: The rhizospheric and endophytic bacterial community of wheat plants (Triticum aes-tivum L.) is not altered by the application of wastewater
description: Wheat plants cultivated under controlled conditions in the greenhouse were amended with wastewater before emerging and after 81 days. The bulk soil and rhizosphere bacteria, and root and stem endophytes were determined after 20, 81 and 84 days and at harvest.
center: center for research and advanced studies of the national polytechnic institute
